name: realpath
description: Resolve a path to its canonical absolute form. Follows symlinks on POSIX; normalizes path on Windows. Used by the JS guest skill loader to dedup entries that point at the same on-disk file through different surface paths.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to canonicalize (relative paths resolve against cwd).

inputs.name: resolveLinks
inputs.description: Resolve links on every platform: on Windows follow junctions, symlinks and mapped/subst drives (GetFinalPathNameByHandle), which the default form does not; a path that does not exist yet resolves through its deepest existing ancestor. For containment checks (untrusted read boundary, fsx root rule). Additive, ignore-if-absent: an older host answers the default form. The default stays unresolved on Windows because it feeds the session cwd and session-storage identity.
